headlines.title: 廖岷出席2026年二十国集团财长和央行行长第二次会议
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月2日讯，2026年8月31日至9月1日，二十国集团（G20）主席国美国在美国北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔市举行今年第二次G20财长和央行行长会议。会议主要就全球宏观经济形势、全球增长、全球失衡、国际债务和金融素养等议题进行讨论。财政部副部长廖岷率团出席会议并发言。廖岷表示，当前全球经济面临多重挑战，G20应坚持践行真正的多边主义，进一步加强宏观经济政策协调，推动实现更加强劲的全球增长。G20各方应维护自由贸易，促进普惠包容的经济全球化，为国际贸易和资本流动创造有利的政策环境。人工智能正深刻重塑经济发展模式，各方应坚持合作共赢、弥合数智鸿沟、促进可持续

headlines.title_en: Liao Min Attends the Second G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of 2026
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data reported on September 2 that from August 31 to September 1, 2026, the United States, as G20 president, held the second G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of the year in Asheville, North Carolina. The meeting discussed topics including the global macroeconomic situation, global growth, global imbalances, international debt and financial literacy. Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min led a delegation to attend the meeting and delivered remarks. Liao stated that the global economy currently faces multiple challenges, and the G20 should uphold true multilateralism, further strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and promote stronger global growth. G20 members should safeguard free trade, promote inclusive and beneficial economic globalization, and create a favorable policy environment for international trade and capital flows. Artificial intelligence is profoundly reshaping economic development models, and all parties should uphold win-win cooperation, bridge the digital intelligence divide, and promote sustainability.

headlines.title_en: Wall Street Breakfast | September 2, 2026
headlines.summary_en: With US-Iran conflict escalating, WTI crude surged nearly 6% intraday, breaking above $90 for the first time in a month; global sovereign bond yield indicator hit a record high since 2008. US stocks fell for a third straight session, with Nasdaq down 1%, chip index retreating over 2%; Apple rebounded nearly 3% on new CEO's first day, Dell jumped over 10% after hours on sharply raised full-year guidance. Yen weakened past 160, falling to lowest since US intervention. Chinese President attended SCO Heads of State Council meeting and delivered important speech advocating equal and orderly multipolarity for fairer global governance. The Bishkek Declaration on SCO's 25th anniversary reiterated condemnation of military strikes on Iranian territory and advocated political and diplomatic solutions. China's August RatingDog manufacturing PMI rose to a two-month high of 51.5.

headlines.title: 华泰证券：基金对红利、新能源的关注度明显增强
headlines.summary: 华泰证券指出，前期市场资金面的负反馈风险进一步缓和，但上行的一致性合力仍待增强。交易型资金中，融资资金、龙虎榜资金的流出意愿出现明显缓解，但资金活跃度与杠杆尚未同步扩张，交易型资金的修复斜率仍不稳定；配置型资金中，上周观察到一定的承接迹象，但考虑到美联储央行年会偏鹰、主动配置型外资仍未转向流入，资金流入的持续性有待观测。方向上，基金对红利、新能源的关注度明显增强，科技上硬件侧新发明显回落，软件侧小幅回暖，有色及医药维持相对稳定的发行态势。

headlines.title_en: Huatai Securities: Funds' Attention to Dividends and New Energy Has Significantly Increased
headlines.summary_en: Huatai Securities noted that negative feedback risks in market capital flows have further eased, but upward consensus momentum still needs strengthening. Among trading funds, outflow intentions from margin financing and Dragon-Tiger list funds have notably eased, yet capital activity and leverage have not expanded in tandem, leaving the repair slope of trading funds unstable. Among allocation funds, some absorption signs were observed last week, but given the hawkish Fed meeting and lack of active allocation foreign capital inflows, sustainability of inflows needs monitoring. By sector, funds' attention to dividends and new energy has notably increased; tech hardware issuance has clearly declined while software has slightly recovered; nonferrous metals and pharma maintain relatively stable issuance trends.

headlines.title: China’s factory activity improves in August, but stays in contraction
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity improved in August but remained in contraction territory for a second straight month, as a pickup in orders could not fully offset the impact of overall weak domestic demand and disruptions from extreme weather.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) was 49.8 in August, up from 49.2 in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday. The reading was largely in line with the 49.85 projection from economists polled by the...

headlines.title: 外部因素扰动港股反弹进程，机构建议围绕基本面布局
headlines.summary: 在美联储主席释放鹰派信号、长端美债收益率高企等因素扰动下，港股市场在8月承压，未能延续7月强劲反弹的态势，9月1日延续调整态势。不过从南向资金流向看，8月南向资金再度净流入逾百亿港元，市场并未出现明显悲观情绪。

headlines.title_en: External factors disrupt Hong Kong stock rebound, institutions suggest positioning around fundamentals
headlines.summary_en: Under hawkish Fed signals and high long-end US Treasury yields, Hong Kong stocks faced pressure in August, failing to extend July's strong rebound, with continued adjustments on September 1. However, southbound capital flows saw net inflows exceeding HK$10 billion in August, with no notable pessimism in the market.

headlines.summary_en: Oil and gas sector opened sharply higher, with Keli shares up over 10% at open; Tongyuan Petroleum, Huibopu, Zhongman Petroleum, PetroChina Oilfield Services, CNOOC followed.
